/* Main page tables fill the content well, LOTR-wiki style. */
.page-Main_Page .mw-parser-output .wikitable {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.page-Main_Page .mw-parser-output .wikitable th,
.page-Main_Page .mw-parser-output .wikitable td {
  vertical-align: top;
}
.swccg-header { z-index: 4; }

/* Main Page: no TOC box, no FlaggedRevs review panel (LOTR wiki has neither). */
.page-Main_Page #toc,
.page-Main_Page .toc,
.page-Main_Page .flaggedrevs_short,
.page-Main_Page #mw-fr-revision-details,
.page-Main_Page .mw-fr-revision-details,
.page-Main_Page .mw-fr-reviewNotice,
.page-Main_Page .fr-text-stable,
.page-Main_Page .fr-text-current {
  display: none !important;
}

#p-logo {
  height: 170px;
}
#p-logo a.mw-wiki-logo {
  background-image: url(/resources/assets/swccg-wiki-logo.png?v=5) !important;
  background-size: contain !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
  background-position: center top !important;
  width: 160px;
  height: 160px;
}
